strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-00: Tip: Special Summon "Speed Warrior" or "Quillbolt Hedgehog" with "Junk Synchron" to easily Synchro Summon "Junk Warrior".
Tip: Special Summon "Chronomaly Crystal Bones" to have enough Tribute material for "Emes the Infinity".
Tip: Equip "Mataza the Zapper" to double damage dealt.
Tip: "Turbo Warrior's" ability can help destroy "Goyo Guardian".
Tip: Use "Star Blast" to lower "Summon Reactor ・SK's" Level to 4, and Summon the monster without any Tributes.
Tip: Tribute "Junk Warrior" to Special Summon a powerful "Turret Warrior".
Tip: If there is a problem monster, attack the monster and then Tribute a "Turbo Booster" in Main Phase 2 to destroy it.
Tip: Use "Junk Synchron" and "Junk Warrior" to Synchro Summon "Stardust Dragon".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-01: Tip: With "Imperial Iron Wall", "Hyper Synchron" will not banish "Stardust Dragon" and you can keep reusing "Quillbolt Hedgehog".
Tip: Summon "Psychic Jumper" and another Psychic-Type monster on the same turn to steal the "Power Tool Dragon".
Tip: Use Psi-Station to make summoning higher Level Synchro Monsters easier.
Tip: When your Life Points are greater than your opponent's, equip "Megamorph" to an opponent's monster.
Tip: Destroy the Field Spell to destroy "Earthbound Immortals".
Tip: Special Summon "Delta Flyer" with "Trident Warrior", raise "Trident Warrior's" Level, and Sychro Summon "Stardust Dragon".
Tip: Be sure to have two attackers to destroy "Underground Arachnid".
Tip: Change a "Resonator" to Level 4 with "Harmonic Waves" and Synchro Summon with another Level 4 non-Tuner monster.
Tip: Normal Summon "Lonefire Blossom" and then Tribute it to Special Summon "Gigaplant".
Tip: "Junk Archer" can banish "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" and shrink it down in size.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-02: Tip: You will need more than one monster in Attack Postion to protect yourself from "Mirror Force" with "Starlight Road".
Tip: When playing "Reinforcement of the Army", search for "Jutte Fighter" if you need a Level 2 Tuner, or "Junk Synchron" for a Level 3 Tuner.
Tip: "Junk Destroyer" can destroy a face-down "Ryko, Lightsworn Hunter" before it triggers its Flip Effect.
Tip: Use "Polymerization" with "Stardust Dragon" and any Warrior-Type monster to Fusion Summon "Dragon Knight Draco-Equiste".
Tip: Play "Masked Chameleon" if you have a monster with 0 DEF in your Graveyard and Synchro Summon "Red Dragon Archfiend".
Tip: Search for "Blackwing - Breeze the Zephyr" with "Black Whirlwind" to Special Summon it.
Tip: Synchro Summon both "Stardust Dragon" and "Formula Synchron" to Synchro Summon "Shooting Star Dragon".
Tip: Be careful. The opponent may Special Summon "Meklord Emperor Skiel" if you destroy a monster with an effect.
Tip: Special Summon a Level 5 monster first. Then, summon a Level 3 Tuner Monster to Synchro Summon "Red Dragon Archfiend".
Tip: Use "Breakthrough Skill" to negate "Meklord" effects.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-03: Tip: Tribute Summon "Salvage Warrior" and Special Summon "Junk Synchron" to Synchro Summon "Stardust Dragon".
Tip: Synchro Summon "Power Tool Dragon" and equip an Equip Spell to negate the Timelord monsters' effects.
Tip: Use "One for One" to summon two "Block Spider" monsters and prevent your opponent from attacking.
Tip: Pendulum Summon when "Performapal Sword Fish" is in play.
Tip: Fusion Summon "Gem-Knight Topaz" first. Then, copy its ability to attack twice with "Gem-Knight Master Diamond".
Tip: When "Giant Rat" is destroyed, Special Summon "Superheavy Samurai Big Benkei".
Tip: Negate effects against "Rune-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" with "Skill Prisoner".
Tip: Fusion summon "Bloom Diva the Melodious Choir" and attack Special Summoned monsters.
Tip: Activate "Performapal Pinch Helper" to summon a Beast-Type monster.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-04: Tip: When Summoning "Raidraptor - Tribute Lanius", send "Raidraptor - Fuzzy Lanius" to the Graveyard.
Tip: Special Summon "Speedroid Terrortop" and search for "Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice".
Tip: Special Summon "Lunalight Cat Dancer" in Attack Position with "Lunalight White Rabbit" and "Final Attack Orders".
Tip: Place "Twilight Ninja Jogen" in your Pendulum Zone to give your attacking Ninja monsters a boost.
Tip: Special Summon "Performapal Helpprincess" to Xyz Summon "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon".
Tip: Summon "Speedroid Double Yoyo", target "Speedroid Tri-Eyed Dice", and summon "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon".
Tip: Be careful of activating targeting effects when the opponent has "Superheavy Samurai Flutist" in the Graveyard.
Tip: Banish your opponent's Spell Cards in the Graveyard with "Schuberta the Melodious Maestra".
Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Doom Double Force" when "Raidraptor - Rise Falcon" is destroyed.
Tip: "Mist Bird Clausolas" can reduce a large monster to manageable size.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-05: Tip: Use "Xiangke Magician" and "Xiangsheng Magician" on "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon" for a Level 7 Xyz monster.
Tip: Special Summon "Speedroid Taketomborg" and tribute it for "Speedroid Tri-Eyed Dice".
Tip: Set "Performapal Handstandaccoon" to return the opponent's Synchro monsters back to the Extra Deck.
Tip: Synchro Summon "D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried" with "D/D Lamia" to negate Spell effects.
Tip: Summon two "Dragoncaller Magicians" to Xyz Summon "Odd-Eyes Rebellion Dragon".
Tip: Ritual Summon "Cyber Angel Vrash" to destroy "Fullmetalfoes Alkahest".
Tip: Fusion Summon "Brave-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" to attack "Destiny HERO - Dystopia".
Tip: Special Summon and Tribute "Cipher Wing" to change other Cipher monsters to Level 8 until the end of the turn.
Tip: Summon a Windwitch monster, activate "One for One", and Special Summon "Fusion Parasite" to Fusion Summon "Windwitch - Crystal Bell".
Tip: Destroy a monster with "Raidraptor - Tribute Lanius" to add "Rank-Up-Magic Revolution Force" to your hand.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-06: Tip: Summon "Predaplant Spinodionaea", attack a lower level monster, and Special Summon "Predaplant Chlamydosundew".
Tip: Use "Performapal Coin Dragon" effects in the Pendulum Zone or on the Field to prevent "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon's" destruction effect.
Tip: Place "D/D Savant Copernicus" and "D/D Savant Newton" in the Pendulum Zones to Pendulum Summon.
Tip: Place "Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon" in the Pendulum Zone to stall your opponent.
Tip: Place "Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon" in the Pendulum Zone to replenish your destroyed Odd-Eyes monsters.
Help Yugi Muto explain the rules of Duel Monsters to Joey Wheeler.
Seto Kaiba defeated Solomon Muto and has destroyed his rare Blue-Eyes White Dragon card!
Tip: "Heart of the Underdog" can help you gather the five pieces of the "Forbidden One".
The Duelist Tournament has begun! In the first round it is Yugi Muto versus the underhanded and sneaky Weevil Underwood.
Tip: Destroy Field Spells with "Burning Land" to keep Insect-Type monsters from growing.
Joey Wheeler faces off against Mai Valentine in his first duel in the tournament.
Tip: When in trouble, take a chance with "Time Wizard".
Yugi Muto encounters the mighty fisherman, Mako Tusnami.
Tip: "Attack the Moon!" to make the "Umi" recede.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-07: Joey Wheeler goes up against Rex Raptor.
Tip: Tribute your opponent's big monsters with "Soul Exchange" to turn the tables.
Tip: Set your Spell Cards on the field to keep them from getting discarded.
Yugi Muto encountersThe deadly Player Killer, PaniK who has been sent to eliminate other duelists from the tournament
Tip: Play defensive, and let "Catapult Turtle" do all the heavy damage.
Tip: Use "Shield & Sword" to switch the opponent's high ATK with their low DEF.
Seto Kaiba and Yugi Muto duel to see who will enter Pegasus Castle and the final round.
Tip: Gather 3 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" to Fusion Summon "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon".
Tea Gardner duels Mai Valentine so that she can win Star Chips for Yugi Muto.
Tip: Be careful of Mai's spell destruction cards. Play Equip Spells only when you need to.
Tip: Wait for the right time to snatch a "Blue-Eyes White Dragon".
The Duelist Kingdom finals have begun and the first round is between Yugi Muto and Mai Valentine.
Tip: You'll need a total Level of 8 to Ritual Summon "Black Luster Soldier".
Joey Wheeler is supposed to duel Bandit Keith but he can't find his entry card!
Tip: Use the opponent's "Mausoleum of the Emperor" to bring out your own high level monsters.
Yugi and Joey duel to see who will go up against Maxmillion Pegasus in the final duel.
Tip: Fusion Summon with cards from your hand to make the most out of "Polymerization".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-08: In the final duel of the Duelist Kingdom tournament there is much more on the line than just the title of King of the Games.
Tip: Wait for Pegasus to summon Toon Monsters before destroying "Toon World".
A mysterious fortune teller has stolen Yugi's Millennium Puzzle and he must duel him to get it back.
Tip: Save your "Mirror Force" for large threats.
The Battle City Tournament has begun! Yugi duels a Rare Hunter to get one of Joey's cards back.
Tip: Stay aggressive, and defeat your opponent before they assemble "Exodia the Forbidden One".
Yugi has been led to a Mystic Box and into an underground chamber where he must duel one of The Rare Hunters, Arkana!
Tip: "Dark Magician Girl" gains ATK from "Dark Magicians" in the opponent's Graveyard, also.
Battle City continues as Joey duels Weevil Underwood, who is still up to is old tricks.
Tip: Hold onto "Baby Dragon" to Fusion Summon.
Yugi encounters a mime called Strings, who is in posession of a very powerful card.
Tip: You can also win if your opponent cannot draw a card during the Draw Phase.
The Battle City quarter-finals have started and the first duel is between Yugi and Bakura.
Tip: Attack often to win before "Destiny Board" is completed.
Joey has been randomly selected to duel Odion, the adopted brother of Marki and Ishizu
Tip: "Jinzo" can stop all the trap monsters.
Seto Kaiba faces off against Ishizu Ishtar in the last duel of The Battle City quarter-finals
Tip: Use "Soul Exchange" to help summon "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or "Obelisk the Tormentor".
Yugi is up against Seto Kaiba in The Battle City semi-finals.
Tip: Keep some cards in hand to power "Slifer the Sky Dragon".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-09: It is the final duel of The Battle City tournament with Yugi dueling against Marik.
Tip: Tokens summoned with "Fiend's Sanctuary" can be used for Tribute Summons.
Tip: Keep a Spellcaster in hand to summon a "Time Magic Hammer" with "The Claw of Hermos".
Tip: Hold onto "Crush Card Virus" and "Tyrant Wing" for "The Fang of Critias".
Tip: You can chain the effect of "Lord of the Red" to your own card effects to destroy a card your opponent controls.
Tip: Use "Kuribandit" to put a Dark Magician card in the Graveyard and "Monster Reborn" in hand.
Tip: Set "Obnoxious Celtic Guard" to protect your Life Points.
With the Millennium Items returned and seet, Yugi duels against The Pharaoh Atem in the final ritual.
Tip: Keep "Silent Magician LV4" growing with "Swords of Revealing Light".
Jaden Yuki has been given a chance to enter the most prestigious Duel Academy in the world.
Dr. Crowler tries to get revenge on Jaden for making a mockery of him in the entrance duel.
Tip: Search for pairs of "Elemental HERO" monsters to Fusion Summon.
Jaden and his friends encounter a shadowy figure while exploring an abandoned dorm.
Tip: "Skyscraper" will help HEROs tackle the largest monsters.
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-10: Jaden duels Zane in an attempt to cheer Syrus up.
Tip: Use "Machine Duplication" with "Cyber Dragon Core" for maximum damage.
Tip: Wait until your opponent powers up his monsters before using your monster destroying cards.
Tip: "Elemental HERO Wildedge" and "Elemental HERO Bladedge" can make short work of "Red-Eyes B. Dragon".
Tip: Be careful of "Vampire Kingdom". It gives 500 ATK when a Vampire deals damage.
Tip: Set "Elemental HERO Clayman" in Defense Position to hold back most attacks.
Tip: Lock down your opponent with "Messenger of Peace" and attack directly.
Tip: "Future Fusion" for "Elemental HERO Electrum" and shrink "Helios" down in size.
Tip: "Elemental HERO Thunder Giant" can easily destory "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames".
Tip: Only use "Limiter Removal" to finish off your opponent or tackle a large monster
Zane Truesdale as finished at the top of the class and has choosen to duel Jaden Yuki at the prestigious graduation match.
Tip: Set "Battle Fusion" to protect your "Fusion Monsters".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-11: A top-ranked duelist has come to Duel Academy and duels Jaden.
Tip: Stay defensive until you can Fusion Summon "Elemental HERO Phoenix Enforcer"s.
Tip: Play "Future Fusion" to quickly summon "Cyber End Dragon".
Jaden duels Chazz with Chazz's Ojama cards hoping to free him from The Society of Light.
Tip: Play "Soul Charge" to Special Summon "Ojama" monsters into play and destroy your opponent with "Ojama Delta Hurricane!!"
Tip: Put "Toon Kingdom" in your hand with "Toon Table of Contents".
Jaden finds that more and more people are being controlled by the society of light. He must duel Alexis to free her from their grasp.
Tip: Only Fusion Summon "Elemental HERO Flare Neos" when you are going for the victory.
Tip: If "Five-Headed Dragon" is sent to the Graveyard with "Fusion Guard", it can be equipped to "Cyberdark Dragon".
Jaden must defeat Sartorius in order to save the world.
Tip: With "Neo Space" in play, don't activate "Neos" Fusion Monsters' "Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck" effect at the End Phase.
Final round of the GX tournament has begun and it is Chazz up against Blair.
Tip: Select "Ojamagic" when activating "Magical Hats" to fill your hand of "Ojama" monsters.
Jaden starts his third year at The Duel Acadmey
Tip: Destroyed "Crystal Beast" monsters become Continuous Spell Cards and will power up your "Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab".
Tip: During your Battle Phase, activate "Contact Out" after your "Neos" Fusion Monster attacks to get another attack with "Elemental Hero Neos".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-12: Tip: Fill the Graveyard with Rock-Type monsters to Special Summon "Gaia Plate the Earth Giant".
Tip: Fog Counters are easier to keep when they are on your "Cloudian" monsters.
Tip: If your monsters ATK has been reduced, use them to Fusion or Tribute Summon another monster.
Jesse duels Zane from another dimension.
Tip: Special Summon with "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" if you need an open Zone to play spells.
Jaden duels Marcel in an attempt to escape from another dimension.
Tip: Set your Spells and Trap Cards to get the most out of "Hero Counterattack".
Jaden duels Yubel to free Jesse from her control .
Tip: Use "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon using your "Elemental HERO Neos" and the opponent's "Rainbow Dragon".
Jaden duels Yubel in the final confrontation.
Tip: Use "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon with "Yubel".
Tip: To use "Wrath of Neos", activate "Elemental HERO Prisma's" effect to change his name to "Elemental HERO Neos".
Tip: Attack with "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" to get rid of the "Black Luster Soldier".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-13: Tip: Tribute with "RAM Clouder" to revive "Decode Talker".
Tip: Summon "Draconnet", "Link Spider", then a Normal Cyberse Monster for "Encode Talker".
Tip: Use "Baby Tiragon's" effect to make "Stinging Swordsman" attack directly.
Tip: Raise your opponent's monster's ATK with "Gravity Axe - Grarl". Then, "Fiery Fervor" will double your monster's ATK.
Tip: Change "Gagaga Magician's" Level to 1. Then, "Baby Tiragon's" effect will allow him to attack directly.
Tip: After "Number 96: Dark Mist" has activated its effect and gained half the ATK, play "Rush Recklessly" to increase your monster's ATK.
Tip: Use "Mirror Mail" with "Rush Recklessly" or "Waboku" to destroy a powerful attacker.
Tip: Use "Number 39: Utopia's" effect to negate its own attack. Then, play "Double or Nothing!" to have "Utopia" attack again but with double ATK.
Tip: Play "Photon Sanctuary" and then Tribute the Tokens to Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-14: Tip: Summon "Galaxy Knight" and play "Galaxy Expedition" to Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".
Tip: Attack a powerful monster with "Shocktopus" to reduce its ATK to 0.
Tip: When your opponent has 800 or less LP, Xyz Summon "Gagaga Cowboy" and use his Defense Position effect.
Tip: Tribute "Gogogo Goram" to Special Summon a "Gogogo Golem - Golden Form" with the greatest ATK.
Tip: Equip "Utopia" with "ZW - Tornado Bringer" to stop the effects of "Number 8: Heraldic King Genom-Heritage".
Tip: If "Number 39: Utopia" has no Xyz Material, Xyz Summon "Number C39: Utopia Ray" to make it harder to destroy.
Tip: Save "Phoenix Wing Wind Blast" for your opponent's Xyz Monsters.
Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force" on "Number 39: Utopia" to Xyz Summon "Number C39: Utopia Ray V".
Tip: Get 2 Fish-Type monsters into the Graveyard quickly to set up for the "Splash Capture" Trap Card.
Tip: Change "Galaxy Wizard's" Level to 8 to play "Galaxy Expedition".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-15: Tip: Xyz Summon with "Rank-Up-Magic Numeron Force" to negate the effects of "Swords of Revealing Light" and other face-up cards.
Tip: If you use "Xyz Shift" on "Heroic Champion - Excalibur" into "Number 39: Utopia", Xyz Summon "Number C39: Utopia Ray" to keep it in play.
Tip: Rank 4 Xyz Monsters do not have a Level and are not affected by "Bubble Bringer".
Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Numeron Force" to negate "Dark Mist's" effect.
Tip: After attacking with "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK", play "Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos" to attack again with "Number C101: Silent Honor DARK".
Tip: Change "Gagaga Magician's" Level to 7 before Special Summoning "Gagaga Child" to Xyz Summon "Number 11: Big Eye".
Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Astral Force" and use "Number 39: Utopia" to Xyz Summon "Number 39: Utopia Beyond".
Tip: Equip "Magnum Shield" to "Gagaga Cowboy" to make the strongest monster.
Tip: Activate "Cynet Universe" in Main Phase 2 to return destroyed "Rokket" monsters to the deck.
Tip: Activate "Balancer Lord" to Summon an additional Cyberse monster and Link Summon "Excode Talker".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-16: Tip: Activate "Firewall Dragon" to return "Tindangle" monsters to the hand and reduce "Tindangle Acute Cerberus's" ATK to 0.
Tip: Special Summon a "Rokket" monster to a zone "Topologic Bomber Dragon" points to and destroy all other monsters.
Tip: Banish "Rose Lover" in the graveyard to Special Summon "Aromage Bergamot".
Tip: Link Summon "Talkback Lancer" to Special Summon a "Code Talker" monster from your graveyard.
Tip: Link Summon "Borreload Dragon" to take a monster, or Summon "Borrelsword Dragon" to deal massive damage.
Tip: Link Summon "Powercode Talker" to negate monster effects and attack with a high ATK monster.
Tip: Banish "Cyberse Magician" and "Cynet Ritual" for 2 tokens, and Link Summon "Honeybot".
Tip: Activate "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon with the opponent's Link Monster.
Tip: Use "Dragon Shrine" to send a Level 7 DARK Dragon to the graveyard. Then summon it with "Rokket Synchron".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-17: Tip: Special Summon "Mecha Phantom Beast Coltwing" with "Scramble!! Scramble!!" for additional tokens.
Tip: Synchro Summon "Borreload Savage Dragon" with "Rokket Synchron" and "Statue of Anguish Pattern".
Tip: Xyz Summon "Artorigus, King of the Noble Knights" to destroy the opponent's life gaining Spell and Trap cards.
Tip: Link Summon with Xyz Monster "Salamangreat Miragestallio" to send your opponent's monster back to the hand.
Tip: Take your opponent's monster with "Mind Control" and then Fusion Summon with it.
Tip: Fusion Summon "El Shaddoll Winda" to limit your opponent's Special Summons.
Tip: Xyz Summon "Borreload eXcharge Dragon" if you need a high ATK monster to attack with.
Tip: Special Summon "Cyberse Synchron" with "Widget Kid" to Synchro Summon "Cyberse Quantum Dragon".
Tip: Special Summon with "Machine Duplication". Then, Link Summon "Missus Radiant".
strings.mission/link-evolution/link-evolution-18: Tip: Link Summon to free up your Main Monster Zones. Then, Special Summon with "Ignister A.I.Land".
Tip: Summon "Achichi @Ignister" to add and Special Summon "Hiyari @Ignister".
Tip: Special Summon "Salamangreat Jack Jaguar" with "Salamangreat Miragestallio" and then Link Summon with both.
Tip: Summon "Salamangreat Gazelle" to send "Salamangreat Spinny" to the graveyard.
Tip: Use "Cynet Backdoor" to protect your Cyberse monster.
Tip: Synchro Summon "Junk Warrior" with Level 2 monsters in play to power it up.
strings.package/link-evolution/description: Relive six generations of dueling with the original story decks and campaign dialogue.
